ProgramUnit.Name: CALC_HOURS_ON_SCHEDULE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This procedure calculates the hours for a staff in a schedule. This considers piggybacks also.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

PROCEDURE calc_hours_on_schedule (p_staff_no in varchar2,
 p_schedule_id in varchar2,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 hours out number) IS
 act_start date ;
 act_end date ;
 last_drive_id varchar2(10) ;
 last_date date ;
 last_hours number ;
 last_start date ;
 pb_drive_id varchar2(10) ;
 counter number := 0 ;
 sub_time number;
 add_time number;
 cursor c1 is
 select ssd.drive_id,drive_date from staff_schedule_details ssd,drives
 where ssd.schedule_id = p_schedule_id
 and staff_no = p_staff_no
 and ssd.chapter_id = p_chapter_id 
 and drives.drive_id = ssd.drive_id
 and drives.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 order by schedule_start_time asc ;
BEGIN
 hours := 0 ;
 for c1rec in c1 loop
--message(c1rec.drive_id || ' ' || counter);
 calc_drive_sch_times(c1rec.drive_id,act_start,act_end,p_chapter_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 /*-- Check if this drive is piggybacked to the last one --*/
 if counter >= 0 then
---1
 if c1rec.drive_date = last_date then
---2
 begin
 select drive_id into pb_drive_id
 from drive_groups
 where drive_group_type = 'PIGGY'
 and drive_group_id = (select drive_group_id from drive_groups
 where drive_id = last_drive_id
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id)
 and drive_id != last_drive_id ;
 if pb_drive_id = c1rec.drive_id then
---3
 calc_drive_sch_times(c1rec.drive_id,act_start,act_end,p_chapter_id) ;
 begin
 SELECT NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_2, 0), NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_3, 0)
 INTO sub_time, add_time
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'JOBTY' 
 AND code = ( SELECT distinct job_code 
 FROM STAFF_SCHEDULE_DETAILS
 WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = p_schedule_id
 and drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 and STAFF_NO = p_staff_no);
 sub_time := sub_time / (24*60) ;
 add_time := add_time / (24*60) ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 sub_time := 0 ;
 add_time := 0 ;
 END;
 act_start := act_start - sub_time;
 act_end := act_end + add_time;
 hours := last_hours + (act_end - last_start) * 24 *60 ;
 act_end := act_start ;
 end if ;
---3 END
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ;
---2 END
 else
---1 ELSE
 begin
 SELECT NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_2, 0), NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_3, 0)
 INTO sub_time, add_time
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'JOBTY' 
 AND code = ( SELECT distinct job_code 
 FROM STAFF_SCHEDULE_DETAILS
 WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = p_schedule_id
 and drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 AND STAFF_NO = p_staff_no) ;
 sub_time := sub_time / (24*60) ;
 add_time := add_time / (24*60) ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 sub_time := 0 ;
 add_time := 0 ;
 END;
 act_start := act_start - sub_time;
 act_end := act_end + add_time;
 end if ;
---1 END
 last_hours := hours ;
 hours := hours + (act_end - act_start)*24 *60 ;
 
 last_drive_id := c1rec.drive_id ;
 last_date := c1rec.drive_date ;
 last_start := act_start ;
 counter := counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: OK_NOK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE OK_NOK(p_sch_date date,ok out number,nok out number) IS
drive_req varchar2(10);
drive_ass varchar2(10);
staff_req number;
staff_ass number;
CURSOR C1 is
 SELECT dr.drive_id, number_reqd
 FROM drive_estimated_resources der, drives dr
 WHERE der.drive_id = dr.drive_id
 AND dr.drive_date = p_sch_date
 AND der.resource_code = 'STAFF'
 AND dr.drive_type in ('I','C')
 AND dr.status != 'CANCL'
 ORDER BY 1;
BEGIN
 FOR C1_rec in C1
 LOOP
 drive_req := C1_rec.drive_id;
 staff_req := C1_rec.number_reqd;
--message('drive req--'||drive_req||'--'||staff_req);pause;
 BEGIN
 SELECT ssd.drive_id, count(staff_no) 
 INTO drive_ass, staff_ass 
 FROM staff_schedule_details ssd, drives dr
 WHERE ssd.drive_id = dr.drive_id
 AND dr.drive_date = p_sch_date
 AND ssd.schedule_id = :ctrl_blk_1.schedule_id
 AND dr.drive_id = drive_req
 AND dr.drive_type in ('I','C')
 AND dr.status != 'CANCL'
 GROUP by ssd.drive_id;
 EXCEPTION when no_data_found then
-- staff_ass := -0 ;
 staff_ass := 0 ;

 END;
/** IF staff_ass = -0 THEN
 ok := nvl(ok,0) ;
 nok := nvl(nok,0);
 ELS
**/
 IF staff_ass >= staff_req THEN
 ok := nvl(ok,0) + 1;
 nok := nvl(nok,0);
 ELSE
 ok := nvl(ok,0);
 nok := nvl(nok,0) + 1 ;
 END IF;
--message('ok --'||ok||'--'||nok);pause;
 END LOOP;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DRIVE_OK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE drive_OK IS
 cursor C1 is
 SELECT dr.drive_id, dr.drive_date, df.facility_code,
 der.number_reqd, count(ssd.staff_no) sa
 FROM drives dr, drive_estimated_resources der, 
 staff_schedule_details ssd, drive_facilities df
 WHERE dr.drive_id = der.drive_id
 AND dr.drive_id = ssd.drive_id
 AND dr.drive_id = df.drive_id
 AND dr.drive_date = :drives.sch_date
 AND der.resource_code = 'STAFF'
 AND dr.drive_type in ('I','C')
 AND dr.status != 'CANCL'
 AND ssd.schedule_id = :ctrl_blk_1.schedule_id
 GROUP BY dr.drive_id, dr.drive_date, df.facility_code, der.number_reqd 
 ORDER BY dr.drive_date, df.facility_code, der.number_reqd;
BEGIN

 go_block('ok_drive');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 FIRST_RECORD;

 FOR C1_rec in C1
 LOOP
--message('11--'||C1_rec.drive_id);pause;
 IF c1_rec.number_reqd = 0 THEN
 :ok_drive.ok_drive_id := C1_rec.drive_id;
 :ok_drive.ok_drive_date := C1_rec.drive_date;
 :ok_drive.ok_facility_code := C1_rec.facility_code;
 :ok_drive.ok_sr := 'P';
 :ok_drive.ok_sa := C1_rec.sa ;
 next_record;
 ELSIF c1_rec.sa >= c1_rec.number_reqd THEN
 :ok_drive.ok_drive_id := C1_rec.drive_id;
 :ok_drive.ok_drive_date := C1_rec.drive_date;
 :ok_drive.ok_facility_code := C1_rec.facility_code;
 :ok_drive.ok_sr := C1_rec.number_reqd;
 :ok_drive.ok_sa := C1_rec.sa ;
 next_record;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 go_block('drives');
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DRIVE_NOK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE drive_NOK IS
drive_req varchar2(10);
drive_ass varchar2(10);
staff_req number;
staff_ass number;
CURSOR C1 is
 SELECT dr.drive_id, dr.drive_date, df.facility_code, number_reqd
 FROM drive_estimated_resources der, drives dr, drive_facilities df
 WHERE dr.drive_id = der.drive_id
 AND dr.drive_id = df.drive_id
 AND dr.drive_date = :drives.sch_date
 AND der.resource_code = 'STAFF'
 AND dr.drive_type in ('I','C')
 AND dr.status != 'CANCL'
 ORDER BY dr.drive_date, df.facility_code, number_reqd;
BEGIN
 go_block('nok_drive');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 FIRST_RECORD;

 FOR C1_rec in C1
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 SELECT ssd.drive_id, count(staff_no) 
 INTO drive_ass, staff_ass 
 FROM staff_schedule_details ssd, drives dr
 WHERE ssd.drive_id = dr.drive_id
 AND dr.drive_date = c1_rec.drive_date
 AND ssd.schedule_id = :ctrl_blk_1.schedule_id
 AND dr.drive_id = c1_rec.drive_id
 AND dr.drive_type in ('I','C')
 AND dr.status != 'CANCL'
 GROUP by ssd.drive_id;
 EXCEPTION when no_data_found then
 staff_ass := 0 ;
 END;

 IF staff_ass < c1_rec.number_reqd THEN
 :nok_drive.nok_drive_id := C1_rec.drive_id;
 :nok_drive.nok_drive_date := C1_rec.drive_date;
 :nok_drive.nok_facility_code := C1_rec.facility_code;
 :nok_drive.nok_sr := C1_rec.number_reqd;
 :nok_drive.nok_sa := staff_ass ;
 next_record;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 go_block('drives');
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DRIVE_TEAM_SIZE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE drive_team_size IS
CURSOR C1 is
 SELECT emp.team_id,vm.sort_sequence_1 ss, count(distinct emp.staff_no) cc
 FROM employees emp, valid_master_codes vm
 WHERE emp.team_id = vm.code
 AND emp.emp_class in ( select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'MANAS' 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate) )
 AND emp.emp_class != 'FSTAF'
 AND vm.code_type = 'TEAMS'
 AND emp.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND nvl(emp.term_date,:ctrl_blk_1.sch_start_date) >= :ctrl_blk_1.sch_start_date
 AND emp.schedule_from_date is not null
 AND emp.schedule_from_date <= :ctrl_blk_1.sch_end_date 
 GROUP BY emp.team_id,vm.sort_sequence_1
 ORDER BY 2,3,1;
BEGIN
 go_block('drive_team_size');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 FIRST_RECORD;
 FOR C1_rec in C1
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 SELECT code 
 INTO :drive_team_size.team_facility_code
 FROM VALID_MASTER_CODES
 WHERE sort_sequence_1 = C1_rec.ss
 AND code_type = 'FACLT' ;
 EXCEPTION when no_data_found THEN
 :drive_team_size.team_facility_code := NULL;
 END;
 :drive_team_size.team_drive_id := C1_rec.team_id;
 :drive_team_size.team_size := C1_rec.cc;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 go_block('drives');
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: OK_DRIVE_TEAM

PROCEDURE ok_drive_team IS
 CURSOR C1 is
 SELECT distinct emp.team_id, count(emp.staff_no) cc
 FROM staff_schedule_details ssd, employees emp
 WHERE ssd.schedule_id = :ctrl_blk_1.schedule_id
 AND ssd.drive_id = :ok_drive.ok_drive_id
 AND ssd.staff_no = emp.staff_no

 FOR C1_rec in C1
 LOOP

 :ctrl_blk_1.ok_team_status := :ctrl_blk_1.ok_team_status ||' '||c1_rec.team_id||':'||c1_rec.cc;
 ELSE
 :ctrl_blk_1.ok_team_status := c1_rec.team_id||':'||c1_rec.cc;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TEAM_USED_AVAIL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE team_used_avail IS
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT count(distinct emp.staff_no) cc
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.team_used
 FROM staff_schedule_details ssd, employees emp, drives dr
 WHERE ssd.schedule_id = :ctrl_blk_1.schedule_id
 AND emp.emp_class in ( select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'MANAS' 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate) )
 AND emp.emp_class != 'FSTAF'
 AND emp.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND emp.team_id = :drive_team_size.team_drive_id
 AND nvl(emp.term_date,:ctrl_blk_1.sch_start_date) >= :ctrl_blk_1.sch_start_date
 AND emp.schedule_from_date is not null
 AND emp.schedule_from_date <= :ctrl_blk_1.sch_end_date 
 AND ssd.staff_no = emp.staff_no 
 AND ssd.drive_id = dr.drive_id
 AND dr.drive_date = :drives.sch_date;



 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 :ctrl_blk_1.team_used := 0;
 END;
 :ctrl_blk_1.team_avail := :drive_team_size.team_size - :ctrl_blk_1.team_used ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DOUBLE_SCHEDULE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE double_schedule IS
 CURSOR C1 is
 SELECT distinct ssd.staff_no, Initcap(emp.first_name||' '||emp.last_name) name,
 ssd.drive_id, dr.drive_date, df.facility_code
 FROM staff_schedule_details ssd, drives dr, employees emp, drive_facilities df
 WHERE ssd.schedule_id = :ctrl_blk_1.schedule_id
 AND ssd.drive_id = dr.drive_id
 AND dr.drive_id = df.drive_id
 AND ssd.staff_no = emp.staff_no
 AND (ssd.staff_no,dr.drive_date) in (
 SELECT distinct ssd.staff_no, dr.drive_date
 FROM staff_schedule_details ssd, drives dr
 WHERE ssd.schedule_id = :ctrl_blk_1.schedule_id
 AND ssd.drive_id = dr.drive_id
 group by staff_no, dr.drive_date
 having count(staff_no) > 1 )
 ORDER BY dr.drive_date, ssd.staff_no ;
BEGIN
 clear_block(no_validate);
 FOR C1_rec in C1
 LOOP
 :double_schedule.double_staff_no := c1_rec.staff_no;
 :double_schedule.double_staff_name := c1_rec.name;
 :double_schedule.double_drive_date := c1_rec.drive_date;
 :double_schedule.double_drive_id := c1_rec.drive_id;
 :double_schedule.double_facility_code := c1_rec.facility_code;
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 BEGIN
 SELECT count(distinct ssd.staff_no||dr.drive_date)
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.total_multi
 FROM staff_schedule_details ssd, drives dr
 WHERE ssd.schedule_id = :ctrl_blk_1.schedule_id
 AND ssd.drive_id = dr.drive_id
 AND (ssd.staff_no,dr.drive_date) in (
 SELECT distinct ssd.staff_no, dr.drive_date
 FROM staff_schedule_details ssd, drives dr
 WHERE ssd.schedule_id = :ctrl_blk_1.schedule_id
 AND ssd.drive_id = dr.drive_id
 group by staff_no, dr.drive_date
 having count(staff_no) > 1 );

 END ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ASSIGN_MODE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE assign_mode IS
 CURSOR C1 is
 SELECT distinct 
decode(ssd.assign_mode,'A', 'Automatic', 'M', 'Manually Assigned',
 'P', 'Pre Assign', 'No Assign Mode') assign_mode,
 count(*) cc
 FROM staff_schedule_details ssd
 WHERE ssd.schedule_id = :ctrl_blk_1.schedule_id 
 GROUP BY assign_mode;
BEGIN
 clear_block(no_validate);
 FOR C1_rec in C1
 LOOP
 :assign_mode.assign_mode := c1_rec.assign_mode;
 :assign_mode.assign_size := c1_rec.cc;
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 FIRST_RECORD;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: STAFF_STATUS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE staff_status IS
CURSOR C1 is
 SELECT distinct emp.emp_class, count(emp.staff_no) staff_count
 FROM employees emp
 WHERE emp.emp_class in ( select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'MANAS' 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate) )
 AND emp.emp_class != 'FSTAF'
 AND emp.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND nvl(emp.term_date,:ctrl_blk_1.sch_start_date) >= :ctrl_blk_1.sch_start_date
 AND emp.schedule_from_date is not null
 AND schedule_from_date <= :ctrl_blk_1.sch_end_date 
 GROUP BY emp.emp_class;

BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT sum(der.number_reqd)
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.total_sr
 FROM drives dr, drive_estimated_resources der
 WHERE dr.drive_id = der.drive_id
 AND dr.drive_date = :drives.sch_date
 AND der.resource_code = 'STAFF'
 AND dr.drive_type in ('I','C')
 AND dr.status != 'CANCL'
 GROUP BY dr.drive_date;
 EXCEPTION when no_data_found THEN
 :ctrl_blk_1.total_sr := 0;
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT count(ssd.staff_no) sa
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.total_sa
 FROM drives dr, staff_schedule_details ssd
 WHERE dr.drive_id = ssd.drive_id
 AND dr.drive_date = :drives.sch_date
 AND dr.drive_type in ('I','C')
 AND dr.status != 'CANCL'
 AND ssd.schedule_id = :ctrl_blk_1.schedule_id
 GROUP BY ssd.schedule_id ;
 EXCEPTION when no_data_found THEN
 :ctrl_blk_1.total_sa := 0;
 END;

 FOR C1_rec in C1
 LOOP
 :staff_status.staff_status_emp_class := C1_rec.emp_class;
 :staff_status.staff_status_count := C1_rec.staff_count;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;
 FIRST_RECORD;
END;

 END IF; 
 END IF; 
END;
